records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales generated in the three months ended June 30, 2024 increased $251.2 million, or 5.8%, from net sales generated in the three months ended June 25, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the second quarter of 2024, the U.S. chicken market experienced robust volume demand, supported by growth in both the retail and foodservice distribution channels throughout the quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Export volume in shipments were lower than the five-year historical average, but were sufficient to prevent buildup of dark meat inventories in cold storage while sustaining price levels which were higher than prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We generated a consolidated operating margin of 7.7%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income increased by $340.5 million, or 339.6%, from income of $100.3 million generated in the three months ended June 25, 2023 to income of $440.8 million generated in the three months ended June 30, 2024.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Our year-over-year revenue increased by $48.7 million to $807.2 million.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We continue to experience increased demand for our power products designed for electrical vehicle applications, and we are working closely with our customer base to best match our supply to their demand.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The significant components of our working capital are liquid assets such as cash and cash equivalents, short-term investments, accounts receivable and inventories, partially reduced by accounts payable and accrued expenses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Gross margin decreased to 9.6% in fiscal 2024 from 32.0% in fiscal 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Operating loss from continuing operations was $445.3 million in fiscal 2024 as compared to $311.8 million in fiscal 2023.
